bio.text: Mariannette Miller-Meeks has served in the U.S. House of Representatives since January 2021, and sits on the Energy and Commerce and Veterans' Affairs committees.
She served in the Iowa State Senate after her 2018 election and was director of the Iowa Department of Public Health from 2010 to 2014.
She served 24 years in the U.S. Army as a private, nurse and physician (ophthalmologist).
